thought.text: The caddy service needs its image line (normally provided by the backend compose file). Let me fix:

reasoning_content:
The caddy service in dev-fixed.yml doesn't have an image specified — that's because I dropped the image line. The dev-compose file overrides the image. In my single-file approach, I have to include the image. Let me add `image: caddy:2.11-alpine` to the caddy service, and while I'm at it, add the missing container_name / init / restart fields to make it equivalent.

Also, I noticed that the pull seems slow (5 minutes in and still on the first image). Let me check the details of the pull.

action.command:
cd /workspace && sed -i 's/^  caddy:\n    environment:/&/' .devcontainer/dev-fixed.yml
python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
p = '.devcontainer/dev-fixed.yml'
s = open(p).read()
s = s.replace("""  caddy:
    environment:""", """  caddy:
    image: caddy:2.11-alpine
    command:
      [
        'caddy',
        'run',
        '--config',
        '/etc/caddy/Caddyfile.local',
        '--adapter',
        'caddyfile',
      ]
    environment:""")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
docker compose -f .devcontainer/dev-fixed.yml config --quiet && echo "COMPOSE FILE VALID"
